## APPENDICITIS WITH PERFORATION
Oral step-down treatment
## Duration of therapy
Adequate source control: 4 days after source control
Incomplete source control & no abscess: 5-7 days tailored to improvement.
Re-evaluate need for source control if ongoing signs/symptoms of infection
beyond 7 days
Abscess: 2-6 weeks depending on resolution on repeat imaging. ID Consult
recommended.
## Treatment
Preferred:
## Inpatient

/Outpatient Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
## Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]
Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
Consider vancomycin for enterococcal coverage in critically ill or
immunosuppressed patients:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] on one of the regimens above
## ER

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV once STAT [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT
[DI]
## Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT [R]
Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV once STAT [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV once STAT [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT
[DI]
Consider vancomycin for enterococcal coverage in critically ill or
immunosuppressed patients:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT [R] on one of the regimens above ##______________________________________________________________________________
